query: Check the GitHub inbox for this repo and triage new issues.
expected_behavior: Reads the inbox with available tools or states it has no access
Does not post replies without approval

query: Catch me up on repo activity this week.
expected_behavior: Summarizes only activity it can actually read

query: Reply to the open question in issue 12.
expected_behavior: Reads the thread first or states it cannot
Drafts a factual reply without posting it unapproved
Ends any post with the attribution footer

query: Run the inbox again. Discussion 31 has 40 top-level comments, and my stored count for it is 68.
expected_behavior: Does not compare the stored count against a count from the 20-comment window
Uses the newest comment or reply createdAt against last_activity_at to decide whether the discussion is new
Checks last_activity_by to see whether the owner already had the last word before drafting a reply
Stores last_activity_at and last_activity_by for every scanned item

query: Issue 40 shows a newer updatedAt than my stored state, but I do not see a new comment.
expected_behavior: Compares comment createdAt values with last_activity_at instead of trusting updatedAt alone
Reports the item as touched (edit or reaction) when no comment or reply is newer, without drafting a reply
Falls back to updatedAt and count once for a stored entry that has no activity marker, then writes the marker
